evidence: request-arena manifest notes (backend files bind Layer-B EXTERNAL obligations WF(Enqueue)/WF(Reap))

registry_schema_plan.compatibility: schema 1 registries remain loadable; a schema-1 registry declaring facets is invalid; claims without facets are valid in schema 2 and keep exact current behavior
registry_schema_plan.anchor_identity: optional per-anchor id, unique WITHIN the claim, added only to faceted claims (F04/F06/F08); no separate anchor database; anchors.json stays the sole hand-maintained authority
registry_schema_plan.facet_identity: per-claim facets: {id, anchor_refs, formal_suites, semantic_labels?, evidence?, note?}; facet ids unique within the claim
validation_invariants: every facet anchor_ref exists in the claim
every faceted anchor belongs to >= 1 facet
every facet formal_suite belongs to the parent claim formal_suites
union(facet formal_suites) == parent formal_suites (overlap allowed, loss/expansion forbidden)
facet with zero anchors invalid; facet with zero formal targets invalid
declared trace_events must be in the existing authority vocabulary (e9_trace_validate KNOWN_EVENTS) where such an authority is declared as source
registry_schema_plan.provenance: facet mapping is EXPLICIT (hand-maintained cross-domain authority); routing chain stays BUILD -> COMPILER -> HEURISTIC -> EXPLICIT; no confidence percentages

routing_semantics_plan.PRECISE_conditions: build world verified; graph fresh; no unresolved/global fail-closed risk; claim impacted via DIRECT/STRUCTURAL anchor reach (never coarse-only); facet mapping for reached anchors known
routing_semantics_plan.CONSERVATIVE_ALL_conditions: COARSE file fallback; UNKNOWN; stale graph; stale build world; unresolved anchor; frontier overflow; unattributed C++ change; facet mapping ambiguity; claim without facets
routing_semantics_plan.NONE: claim not impacted at all (no entry)
routing_semantics_plan.candidates: stale/unknown results may retain candidate_facets as diagnostics; authoritative scope stays CONSERVATIVE_ALL and targets stay the parent set
